tools.name: find_entities
tools.description: Look up the slug MissedTakes uses for a pundit, a publication (outlet), an NFL team, an NFL player or a prediction type, by full or partial name. Call this first whenever the user names someone: the other tools take slugs, never names. Only pundits and outlets with a public page are returned.

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: The ranked NFL pundit leaderboard, the same rows missedtakes.co/nfl/leaderboard prints: MissedTakes Score (skill against a naive baseline, which is the ranking), accuracy, graded takes and articles. tools.name: pundit_record
tools.description: One pundit's published NFL record: overall MissedTakes Score, accuracy and sample size, the record broken down by prediction type, and any Pundit of the Week or Month awards. For their election record, call election_pundit.

tools.name: outlet_record
tools.description: One publication's NFL record, aggregated across everyone writing or speaking under its banner: overall and by prediction type, with how many pundits contribute.

tools.name: list_takes
tools.description: Individual NFL predictions: who made them, when (claimedAt is the publication date), a short excerpt of the wording, the grade (accuracy 0-100, or pending) and the grading arithmetic.
